concurrency: Single-threaded within the owning writer; duplicate detection and ordinal assignment are serialized.
inputs: caller event id, producer id, event kind and optional sequence/correlation/causation
outputs: accepted JSONL event record with ingestionOrdinal
purpose: Enforce the frozen versioned event record contract (schema version, run id, unique event id, producer id, ingestion ordinal, kind, optional sequence and correlation/causation references), assign the local deterministic ingestion ordinal and index causal references without inventing predecessors.
state: Owns no durable state beyond the appended records; owns the in-memory duplicate-identity and causal-index sets bounded by the caller limits.

static_checks.expected: ast.parse succeeds for every planned path; the identity field set and the writer-only kind set are closed
static_checks.rule: python ast parse of the planned schema/causation sources plus a check that the event kind vocabulary, required identity fields and reserved writer-emitted kinds are closed and that the ingestion ordinal is assigned only by the writer
static_checks.tool: repository static inspection (python ast parse and diff/wheel scope check; consumed by the trusted ARGUS2-STATIC measure)

title: ARGUS2-SR-003-U unit specification - Event identity, producer sequence and causal references

unit_cases.expected: one accepted record with schemaVersion '1.0', runId, eventId, producerId, ingestionOrdinal, eventKind and every declared optional field preserved exactly
unit_cases.precondition: an open run and a fully declared event
unit_cases.stimulus: run.append_event(event_id='e7', producer_id='p7', event_kind='annotation', producer_sequence=3, correlation_id='c7', causation_id='e6', annotation={'text': 'n'})

unit_cases.expected: ingestionOrdinal is 1, 2, 3 in append order; the reader returns records in ordinal order and never reorders by clock value
unit_cases.precondition: three appended events whose caller clock values descend
unit_cases.stimulus: append e1, e2, e3 then read

unit_cases.expected: rejected; ARGUS2-INPUT-DUPLICATE-EVENT; no second JSONL line is written and the writer state and stream bytes are unchanged
unit_cases.precondition: an event id already accepted in the same run

unit_cases.expected: rejected; ARGUS2-INPUT-IDENTITY-MISSING; no partial accepted record is retained
unit_cases.precondition: an append whose run id, event id or producer id is absent or empty

unit_cases.expected: ARGUS2-SCHEMA-MAJOR-UNSUPPORTED; the line is not silently accepted, upgraded or dropped
unit_cases.precondition: a persisted JSONL line carrying schemaVersion '2.0'

unit_cases.expected: the reference resolves to the accepted event id; the causal-closure obligation is satisfied; the index holds no invented predecessor
unit_cases.precondition: event e2 declaring causationId equal to the accepted event id e1 and a required causal-closure obligation

unit_cases.expected: ARGUS2-CAUSAL-UNRESOLVED reported; evidenceReasons contains ARGUS2-REASON-UNRESOLVED-CAUSATION; the missing predecessor is never repaired or invented
unit_cases.precondition: event e2 declaring causationId 'e9' which was never appended

unit_cases.expected: rejected; ARGUS2-INPUT-FIELD-INVALID; no line is written
unit_cases.precondition: an event kind outside the closed set

unit_cases.expected: rejected; ARGUS2-INPUT-FIELD-INVALID; the writer-emitted kinds remain writer-only
unit_cases.precondition: an event kind reserved for the writer

unit_cases.expected: rejected; ARGUS2-BOUND-EXCEEDED naming max_text_length; no line is written
unit_cases.precondition: annotation text longer than the caller max_text_length

unit_cases.expected: ARGUS2-SCHEMA-UNKNOWN-FIELD; the unknown key is neither silently ignored nor discarded
unit_cases.precondition: a raw JSONL line carrying an additional key outside extensions

unit_cases.expected: records are returned in ingestion-ordinal order and the declared producer sequences are preserved unchanged and never presented as temporal or causal order
unit_cases.precondition: events appended with producer_sequence values out of append order
unit_cases.stimulus: append e1(seq=5), e2(seq=1), e3(seq=3) then read

unit_cases.expected: ARGUS2-INPUT-IDENTITY-MISSING; the record is excluded from the trusted result and the run is assessed incomplete; no TypeError/KeyError escapes the reader (ARGUS2-ADV-04)
unit_cases.precondition: a persisted stream line whose event omits runId, eventId or producerId

unit_cases.expected: ARGUS2-CORRUPT-DUPLICATE-EVENT; the duplicate is excluded from the trusted result and the run is assessed incomplete (ARGUS2-ADV-04)
unit_cases.precondition: a stream carrying the same eventId twice within one run

unit_cases.expected: ARGUS2-CORRUPT-ORDINAL; the out-of-sequence record is excluded and the ordinal is never presented as temporal or causal order (ARGUS2-ADV-04)
unit_cases.precondition: a stream whose ingestionOrdinal repeats, skips a value or does not start at 1

unit_cases.expected: ARGUS2-CORRUPT-RUN-ID-MISMATCH; the mismatched record is excluded and the run is assessed incomplete (ARGUS2-ADV-04)
unit_cases.precondition: a stream event whose runId differs from the manifest runId

unit_cases.expected: ARGUS2-INPUT-NONFINITE (or ARGUS2-CLOCK-UNRESOLVED for a non-numeric clock); the value never enters the trusted result and no uncaught ValueError escapes (ARGUS2-ADV-04)
unit_cases.precondition: a persisted stream clock value of NaN/Infinity, or a non-numeric clock value
